learner_persona: child learner building reading and language skills in the stated age band
scope_boundary: skills scope as defined in the course blueprint; not an official vendor credential
duration_basis: curriculum specification (design assumption, see course package)
mcq_limitation_note: Assesses knowledge and applied reasoning through selection items; does not assess hands-on performance.
certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Learning to Read (Ages 5-7)

learning_outcomes.text: Hold a book correctly and follow print from left to right, top to bottom
Use letter sounds and blending to decode unfamiliar words
Read a growing set of common words on sight
Use picture clues to support understanding of a story
Retell the main events of a simple story in order
Build reading confidence and stamina with short decodable books

integrative_case: A learner picks a short story book, reads it from the first page to the last using sounds, sight words and pictures, then retells what happened in the right order to the class.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
does_not_assess: Assesses knowledge and applied reasoning through selection items; does not assess hands-on performance.

time_plan.rounding_rule: I = round-half-up(0.8 x T); A = T - I
